spec.description: Browse any recent Cannonball-SE game. Click a row in the 'Recent games' table (Loki, one row per game, newest first) to load it — every panel below is scoped to that game via session_label, exact at ANY time range. Widen the range to browse further back; Loki keeps full history (no Tempo tag-values cap). Unlike 'Now Playing' this does NOT auto-follow — you choose the game. Loki-only: no Tempo dependency. Generated from live_game_dashboard.json by generate.py — edit the live board, then regenerate. Requires grafana-graphviz-panel and marcusolsson-dynamictext-panel.

spec.title: Game Selector
spec.description: Every game seen in the current time range, newest first (session_label sorts lexically by its timestamp prefix). Click a row to load that game into the panels below. Widen the time range to browse further back — Loki keeps full history, with none of the Tempo tag-values cap the old picker suffered.

spec.title: Game state
spec.description: completion_code of the selected session: 1 = COMPLETED, 2 = TIMED OUT, null = IN PROGRESS (no end yet).

spec.title: Stage reached
spec.description: Highest stage_number reached in the selected session.

spec.title: Off-road
spec.description: Number of times the car went off-road (game.off_road events) in the selected game.

spec.title: Avg speed
spec.description: Mean speed_kph across this session's events. NOTE: speed_kph is only logged on crash / off-road / stage-start / route / overtake events, so this is a sampled average weighted toward eventful moments, not a true whole-lap mean.

spec.title: Top speed
spec.description: Highest speed_kph seen across any event in this session.

spec.title: Score
spec.description: Latest score for the selected game — updates through the game via in-game events (crashes, overtakes, route choices).

spec.title: Crashes by type
spec.description: Crash count grouped by crash_type (bump / spin / flip) for the selected session.

spec.expression: SELECT t.label AS crash_type, COALESCE(a.cnt, 0) AS crashes FROM (SELECT 'bump' AS ct, 'Bump' AS label UNION ALL SELECT 'flip','Flip' UNION ALL SELECT 'spin','Spin') t LEFT JOIN (SELECT crash_type, `__value__` AS cnt FROM A) a ON a.crash_type = t.ct ORDER BY crashes DESC

spec.title: Overtakes by vehicle
spec.description: Overtake count grouped by vehicle (porsche, corvette, bmw, beetle, pickup, truck).

spec.title: Fastest crash
spec.description: Speed (km/h) of the fastest crash in the selected game — max speed_kph over game.crash events.

spec.title: 🗺️ Route taken (map)
spec.description: The OutRun map. Nodes visited by the selected session are populated with a visit count via the panel's node-id matching (node id = stage_id). Every stage 1-5 emits game.stage.start, including Coconut Beach (stage_id 0), so the whole route populates. Tip: add a Node override coloured by the injected value to fully highlight the path.

spec.expression: SELECT DISTINCT s.sid AS stage_id, CASE WHEN s.sid = (SELECT sid FROM (SELECT Line AS sid, `Time` AS t FROM A) q ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 1) AND (SELECT Line FROM B LIMIT 1) = 'timeout' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS status FROM (SELECT Line AS sid FROM A) s
SELECT CONCAT(prev,'__to__',sid) AS edge_id, 1 AS taken FROM (SELECT sid, lag(sid) OVER (ORDER BY t ASC) AS prev FROM (SELECT `Time` AS t, Line AS sid FROM A) q1) q2 WHERE prev IS NOT NULL

spec.title: 📷 Key moments
spec.description: Every screenshot captured during the game, in the order it occurred (oldest first).

spec.title: Player
spec.description: player_initials of the selected game.

spec.title: Overtakes by color
spec.description: Overtake count grouped by the overtaken vehicle's color.

spec.title: Total events
spec.description: Total game events (log lines) captured for the selected game.

spec.title: 🎵 Music
spec.description: music_selection for the selected game (numeric for now; track-name mappings TBD).

spec.title: Total crashes
spec.description: Total crashes in the selected game.

spec.title: Total overtakes
spec.description: Total vehicles overtaken in the selected game.

spec.title: Game duration
spec.description: Wall-clock duration of the selected game (session.end epoch minus session.start epoch).

spec.expr: (max(max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.session.end" | unwrap end_epoch_ms [$__range])) - max(max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.session.start" | unwrap start_epoch_ms [$__range]))) / 1000

spec.title: Rank: Overall
spec.description: This game's rank by final score among all games in the dashboard time range (1 = highest score).

spec.expression: SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 AS game_rank FROM A WHERE `__value__` > (SELECT MAX(`__value__`) FROM B)

spec.title: Gearbox
spec.description: Transmission mode of the selected game (gearbox_mode on game.session.start): Auto or Manual.

spec.expression: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT Line FROM A ORDER BY `Time` DESC LIMIT 1) = 'automatic' THEN 1 WHEN (SELECT Line FROM A ORDER BY `Time` DESC LIMIT 1) = 'manual' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END AS gearbox

spec.title: Longest clean streak
spec.description: Longest continuous stretch of clean driving (no crash / off-road) in the selected game, in seconds.

spec.title: Rank: Game duration
spec.description: Rank by game duration among all games in the dashboard time range (1 = longest).

spec.expr: (max by (session_label) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | event="game.session.end" | unwrap end_epoch_ms [$__range])) - max by (session_label) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | event="game.session.start" | unwrap start_epoch_ms [$__range]))) / 1000

(max(max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.session.end" | unwrap end_epoch_ms [$__range])) - max(max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.session.start" | unwrap start_epoch_ms [$__range]))) / 1000

spec.expression: SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 AS game_rank FROM A WHERE `__value__` > (SELECT MAX(`__value__`) FROM B)

spec.title: Rank: Overtaking
spec.description: Rank by total overtakes among all games in the dashboard time range (1 = most).

spec.expression: SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 AS game_rank FROM A WHERE `__value__` > (SELECT MAX(`__value__`) FROM B)

spec.title: Rank: Average speed
spec.description: Rank by average speed (km/h) among all games in the dashboard time range (1 = fastest).

spec.expression: SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 AS game_rank FROM A WHERE `__value__` > (SELECT MAX(`__value__`) FROM B)

spec.title: Rank: Clean streak
spec.description: Rank by longest clean-driving streak among all games in the dashboard time range (1 = longest).

spec.expression: SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 AS game_rank FROM A WHERE `__value__` > (SELECT MAX(`__value__`) FROM B)

spec.title: Fastest overtake
spec.description: Top speed (km/h) at which an overtake happened in the selected game.

spec.title: Rank: Fastest overtake
spec.description: Rank by fastest overtake speed among all games in the dashboard time range (1 = fastest).

spec.expression: SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 AS game_rank FROM A WHERE `__value__` > (SELECT MAX(`__value__`) FROM B)

spec.title: ⏱️ Time per stage
spec.description: Share of total game time spent on each stage — each segment is that stage's % of the game's total duration (stage_duration_seconds on game.stage.end, incl. the final stage to game over). Percent-stacked to 100%; hover for exact seconds and %.

spec.expr: max by (player_initials) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.stage.end" | stage_number="1" | unwrap stage_duration_seconds [$__range]))
max by (player_initials) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.stage.end" | stage_number="2" | unwrap stage_duration_seconds [$__range]))
max by (player_initials) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.stage.end" | stage_number="3" | unwrap stage_duration_seconds [$__range]))
max by (player_initials) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.stage.end" | stage_number="4" | unwrap stage_duration_seconds [$__range]))
max by (player_initials) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.stage.end" | stage_number="5" | unwrap stage_duration_seconds [$__range]))

spec.title: Overtake speeds
spec.description: Overtakes bucketed by speed (10 km/h bins) in the selected game.

spec.expression: SELECT CAST(FLOOR(CAST(Line AS DOUBLE)/10)*10 AS CHAR) AS speed_kmh, COUNT(*) AS overtakes FROM A GROUP BY speed_kmh ORDER BY CAST(speed_kmh AS DOUBLE)

spec.title: ⏱️ Checkpoint time buffer
spec.description: Seconds left on the clock at each checkpoint (game.stage.end time_remaining_seconds), stages 1-5. Uncompleted stages show 0.

spec.expr: max by (stage_number) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.stage.end" | unwrap time_remaining_seconds [$__range]))

spec.expression: SELECT t.label AS stage, COALESCE(a.secs, 0) AS seconds FROM (SELECT '1' AS n, 'Stage 1' AS label UNION ALL SELECT '2','Stage 2' UNION ALL SELECT '3','Stage 3' UNION ALL SELECT '4','Stage 4' UNION ALL SELECT '5','Stage 5') t LEFT JOIN (SELECT stage_number, `__value__` AS secs FROM A) a ON a.stage_number = t.n ORDER BY t.n

spec.title: Score per stage
spec.description: Share of the final score earned in each stage — each segment is that stage's % of total points (score_end - score_start per stage). Percent-stacked to 100%; hover for exact points and %.

spec.expr: (max by (player_initials) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.stage.end" | stage_number="1" | unwrap score_end [$__range])) - max by (player_initials) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.stage.start" | stage_number="1" | unwrap score_start [$__range])))

(max by (player_initials) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.stage.end" | stage_number="2" | unwrap score_end [$__range])) - max by (player_initials) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.stage.start" | stage_number="2" | unwrap score_start [$__range])))

(max by (player_initials) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.stage.end" | stage_number="3" | unwrap score_end [$__range])) - max by (player_initials) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.stage.start" | stage_number="3" | unwrap score_start [$__range])))

(max by (player_initials) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.stage.end" | stage_number="4" | unwrap score_end [$__range])) - max by (player_initials) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.stage.start" | stage_number="4" | unwrap score_start [$__range])))

(max by (player_initials) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.stage.end" | stage_number="5" | unwrap score_end [$__range])) - max by (player_initials) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | session_label="$session" | event="game.stage.start" | stage_number="5" | unwrap score_start [$__range])))

spec.title: Gear shifts per stage
spec.description: Up/down gear shifts in each stage (game.gear_shift), stages 1-5. In automatic mode a shift is a crossing of the ~160 km/h auto threshold, so this tracks braking/slowdowns per stage; in manual mode it is driver input.

spec.expression: SELECT t.label AS stage, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.direction = 'up' THEN a.cnt END), 0) AS `Up shifts`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.direction = 'down' THEN a.cnt END), 0) AS `Down shifts` FROM (SELECT '1' AS n, 'Stage 1' AS label UNION ALL SELECT '2','Stage 2' UNION ALL SELECT '3','Stage 3' UNION ALL SELECT '4','Stage 4' UNION ALL SELECT '5','Stage 5') t LEFT JOIN (SELECT stage_number, direction, `__value__` AS cnt FROM A) a ON a.stage_number = t.n GROUP BY t.n, t.label ORDER BY t.n

spec.title: Down-shift speeds
spec.description: Down-shifts bucketed by speed (10 km/h bins) in the selected game. In automatic mode a down-shift fires as speed drops back below the ~160 km/h auto threshold, so lower speeds mean harder braking.

spec.expression: SELECT CAST(FLOOR(CAST(Line AS DOUBLE)/10)*10 AS CHAR) AS speed_kmh, COUNT(*) AS downshifts FROM A WHERE CAST(Line AS DOUBLE) > 0 GROUP BY speed_kmh ORDER BY CAST(speed_kmh AS DOUBLE)

spec.title: Incidents by stage
spec.description: Crashes and off-road events in each stage (game.crash + game.off_road), stages 1-5, stacked.

spec.expression: SELECT t.label AS stage, COALESCE(c.cnt, 0) AS `Crashes`, COALESCE(o.cnt, 0) AS `Off-road` FROM (SELECT '1' AS n, 'Stage 1' AS label UNION ALL SELECT '2','Stage 2' UNION ALL SELECT '3','Stage 3' UNION ALL SELECT '4','Stage 4' UNION ALL SELECT '5','Stage 5') t LEFT JOIN (SELECT stage_number, `__value__` AS cnt FROM A) c ON c.stage_number = t.n LEFT JOIN (SELECT stage_number, `__value__` AS cnt FROM B) o ON o.stage_number = t.n ORDER BY t.n

spec.title: Overtakes by stage
spec.description: Vehicles overtaken in each stage (game.vehicle_overtake), stages 1-5.

spec.expression: SELECT t.label AS stage, COALESCE(a.cnt, 0) AS overtakes FROM (SELECT '1' AS n, 'Stage 1' AS label UNION ALL SELECT '2','Stage 2' UNION ALL SELECT '3','Stage 3' UNION ALL SELECT '4','Stage 4' UNION ALL SELECT '5','Stage 5') t LEFT JOIN (SELECT stage_number, `__value__` AS cnt FROM A) a ON a.stage_number = t.n ORDER BY t.n

spec.title: Overtakes by stage
spec.description: Vehicles overtaken in each stage (game.vehicle_overtake), stages 1-5.

spec.title: Up-shift speeds
spec.description: Up-shifts bucketed by speed (10 km/h bins) in the selected game. Meaningful in manual mode (driver picks the shift point); in automatic every up-shift is pinned to the ~160 km/h auto threshold, so it collapses to one bar.

spec.expression: SELECT CAST(FLOOR(CAST(Line AS DOUBLE)/10)*10 AS CHAR) AS speed_kmh, COUNT(*) AS upshifts FROM A WHERE CAST(Line AS DOUBLE) > 0 GROUP BY speed_kmh ORDER BY CAST(speed_kmh AS DOUBLE)

spec.title: Crashes by stage
spec.description: Crashes in each stage by type (game.crash crash_type: bump/spin/flip), stages 1-5, stacked bump→spin→flip.

spec.expression: SELECT t.label AS stage, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.crash_type = 'bump' THEN a.cnt END), 0) AS `Bump`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.crash_type = 'spin' THEN a.cnt END), 0) AS `Spin`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.crash_type = 'flip' THEN a.cnt END), 0) AS `Flip` FROM (SELECT '1' AS n, 'Stage 1' AS label UNION ALL SELECT '2','Stage 2' UNION ALL SELECT '3','Stage 3' UNION ALL SELECT '4','Stage 4' UNION ALL SELECT '5','Stage 5') t LEFT JOIN (SELECT stage_number, crash_type, `__value__` AS cnt FROM A) a ON a.stage_number = t.n GROUP BY t.n, t.label ORDER BY t.n

spec.title: Incidents by stage
spec.description: Crashes and off-road events in each stage (game.crash + game.off_road), stages 1-5, stacked.

spec.title: Crashes by stage
spec.description: Crashes in each stage by type (game.crash crash_type: bump/spin/flip), stages 1-5, stacked bump→spin→flip.

spec.title: Events by stage
spec.description: Total telemetry events of any type recorded in each stage (all game.* events with a stage_number), stages 1-5.

spec.expression: SELECT t.label AS stage, COALESCE(a.cnt, 0) AS events FROM (SELECT '1' AS n, 'Stage 1' AS label UNION ALL SELECT '2','Stage 2' UNION ALL SELECT '3','Stage 3' UNION ALL SELECT '4','Stage 4' UNION ALL SELECT '5','Stage 5') t LEFT JOIN (SELECT stage_number, `__value__` AS cnt FROM A) a ON a.stage_number = t.n ORDER BY t.n

spec.label: Game
spec.description: session_label of the game to view. Click a row in 'Recent games' to set it, or type/paste one.

spec.label: Gearbox mode
